title: Full UI Mockup Alignment — wizard_mockup intake language plus app-wide mockup parity
goal: Make every screen of AegisPT visually align with the mockup system, treating wizard_mockup.html plus ui_mockup.html as the product-wide UI standard rather than as a screen-specific suggestion for only intake or Mission Control.
scope: wizard_mockup.html is authoritative for the intake tone, step treatment, cards, chip language, spacing calmness, and overall product feel across the full UI touched by this slice; ui_mockup.html remains authoritative for the broader screen layouts. ui_mockup.html is the design authority. The mockup establishes a DESIGN SYSTEM that must be consistent across all screens: emoji icons on tiles and cards, capability tags in colored pills (passive=green, active=cyan, credential=amber, exploit=red), numbered selection badges on selected tiles, KEV badges in amber, chain badges in cyan, severity dots as colored circles, finding rows with dot+title+target+tool+badges+arrow. This design language must apply consistently everywhere — not just the intake tiles or Mission Control. Implement the following screen-by-screen changes: (1) FINDINGS: Replace the current split-panel layout (Finding Groups left + Finding Detail right) with the mockup design: a full-width findings list grouped by severity, where clicking a finding slides a detail drawer in from the right (420px wide). The drawer contains: severity badge, risk gauge SVG, methodology chain pills, threat intel badges, terminal evidence block, AutoFix diff block, action buttons. Filter bar: single '▼ Filters' button + 'Group by: Severity ▾' selector. Finding rows: colored severity dot, title, target path, tool name, KEV badge, chain badge, arrow. No SLA queue visible by default on this screen. (2) REPORTS: Replace the current list+metadata split layout with the mockup card grid. Run context strip at top (run name, date, status badge, finding count, reports-ready count). Below: 2-column auto-fill card grid. Each card: report title, 'ready' badge, one-line description, three inline download buttons (↓MD ↓HTML ↓PDF). No separate metadata panel. (3) SIDEBAR: Match the mockup sidebar exactly: OPERATE (Intake, Mission Control, Attack Map), ANALYZE (Findings with red badge count, Reports, History), BUILD (Packs), Settings pinned at bottom. Remove COMPATIBILITY section from primary navigation — Evidence Replay and Explorer remain accessible via compatibility routes but not in the main nav group. (4) MISSION CONTROL: Match the mockup 3-column layout, but make it operationally readable instead of decorative: left column (scan map SVG full height), middle column (compact task list with shimmer, clean aligned cards, severity bars, and a selected-check panel that shows live terminal/stdout output or the latest captured command output for the active/selected task), right column (AI Signal panel dark but concise). Remove the 7-column phase timeline and the Supporting Context section. Replace prose-heavy guidance with compact labels, counts, and short status lines so the operator can see what is actually running, what just ran, and the latest command/output evidence without leaving Mission Control. (5) TOPBAR: Match the mockup topbar exactly: AegisPT logo mark + wordmark | engagement selector with arrow | active run status pill (autonomous badge or count) | notification bell icon | settings gear | user avatar with name. Remove any extra elements not in the mockup.
generation_reason: The user explicitly stated the mockup design is much better than the current implementation and the entire UI should match it. Visual comparison confirms: Findings still uses a split panel (not the drawer from the mockup), Reports uses a list+metadata layout (not the card grid), Mission Control has 10+ sections (not 3 columns), and the sidebar shows a COMPATIBILITY group that is absent in the mockup. ui_mockup.html is the explicit visual reference for all screens.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Visual alignment with ui_mockup.html only. No new features, no new API calls, no new backend endpoints. All existing data-testid selectors on data components must be preserved. Playwright tests must be updated to match the new layouts.

success_criteria: Design system is consistent: emoji icons, capability tags (passive/active/credential/exploit), selection badges, KEV/chain badges, severity dots all use the same colors and styles across every screen.
Findings screen matches ui_mockup.html Findings tab: full-width list + detail drawer slides in on click.
Finding rows show severity dot, title, target, badges (KEV, chain), arrow — matching mockup exactly.
Reports screen matches ui_mockup.html Reports tab: run context strip + 2-column card grid with inline download buttons.
No separate metadata panel in Reports.
Sidebar matches mockup: OPERATE/ANALYZE/BUILD groups, no COMPATIBILITY group in primary nav.
Mission Control matches mockup: 3 columns (scan map | tasks plus selected-task live output | AI signal), no 7-column phase timeline.
Mission Control shows live terminal/stdout output or the latest captured command output for the selected or currently running task without forcing the operator into another screen.
Mission Control cards are compact, aligned, and data-first instead of prose-heavy.
Topbar matches mockup: logo + engagement + status pill + bell + gear + avatar.
The wizard_mockup/ui_mockup standard is applied consistently across the full UI touched by this slice, not treated as a Mission-Control-only or intake-only special case.
Full Playwright suite remains green after layout updates.

acceptance_criteria: Findings drawer slides in on click — no split panel.
Reports shows card grid — no metadata panel.
Sidebar has OPERATE/ANALYZE/BUILD — no COMPATIBILITY group.
Mission Control has 3 columns — no phase timeline.
Mission Control exposes readable live run output in the main screen.
